subject: are there issues when starting many runs of r-stan via subprocess calls by python's multiprocess?

messages.author: 3b16cd5074875dd7
messages.subject: are there issues when starting many runs of r-stan via subprocess calls by python's multiprocess?
parts:
Hi everyone,

if i only run 1 process of rstan at once? i have never gotten issues.

but if i start several processes using python multiprocessing module, and each process calls rstan via the commandline, then i sometimes get errors.

I've attached part of the error msg from terminal.  Thanks.

-Fulton
